title: Revvity
summary: US life-science and diagnostics company spun out of PerkinElmer.
bodyHtml:
Investment Thesis

Revvity sells reagents, instruments and software for drug discovery, diagnostics and reproductive health. Its portfolio includes screening assays, imaging systems and newborn-screening tests. Pharma R&D budgets and diagnostics reimbursement drive revenue.

Technology Exposure

  • Drug-discovery reagents and assays
  • Diagnostics and newborn screening
  • Laboratory software

What To Watch

  • Pharma R&D spending
  • Diagnostics reimbursement
  • China demand

Record Notes

Editorial brief compiled 19 November 2026 from company disclosures, agency publications and press reporting. Figures are as reported by those sources and have not been independently audited; no live market data is used.
